title: Daintree community plugin catalog
description: plugins/catalog.json, published to https://updates.daintree.org/plugins/catalog.json. Each entry pins one reviewed release of a community plugin. This schema describes the shape; Daintree's own parser (electron/services/plugin/pluginCatalogSchema.ts) is what the app enforces, and it also requires that url sits in the entry's repo, matching owner and name without regard to case.

entries.description: Every reviewed release, not just the latest. (id, version) is unique.

id.description: The archive's manifest.name: a scoped publisher.name, outside the daintree.* namespace reserved for builtins.

repo.description: The GitHub repository the release comes from, https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}.

version.description: The archive's manifest.version, as canonical semver with no leading v.

url.description: A versioned .dntr asset of a release in repo: https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/releases/download/{tag}/{asset}.dntr. Never releases/latest/download, and never a tag named latest.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes at url when the entry was reviewed, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

capabilities.description: The archive manifest's capabilities at review time, in the manifest's order. Shown to users, never granted.
